floor_history.headline: Rotation SOLVED: real do-while outer loop + removing the do-while(0) yoff wrap flips the s2/s3/s4 trio to target's exact allocation; floor 29 -> 22
Named the residual's mechanism from the .loop dump (loop.c LICM hoist breaks combine's symbol-into-MEM fold) and killed it for D_80094DF0 with byte-pointer indexing: floor 22 -> 17 at 135/135 insns.

frontier.hypothesis: The inner-loop LICM hoist of regnos 136/137/139 ((const_int 16), (const_int 1), (symbol_ref D_800A9A24)) is the whole residual 17 - the same mechanism solved one level out this session.
frontier.mechanism: move_movables hoists all three out of the 37-insn inner loop and then out of the outer loop; reload rematerializes them count-neutrally but into $t0 instead of target's $v0/$a1, and the LoadImage arg-setup block (addiu a0,sp,24 + the D_800A9A24 la + addu a1) loses its top-of-loop-body schedule slot.
frontier.next_probe: The D_800A9A24 address is consumed as a call ARGUMENT (a value), not as a MEM address, so the scale trick does not transfer directly. Look for a spelling in which the address is consumed by a MEM - that is the case in which loop.c's reg_single_usage substitute-and-delete path (loop.c:735-767) can validate the replacement and DELETE the movable instead of hoisting it. After each form run dump.ps1 and grep the .loop movable log for 'regno 139': its presence/absence is a sharper and faster signal than the sandbox score.

frontier.hypothesis: The y-coordinate temp taking $v0 (target: $v1) is what denies $v0 to the two rematerialized constants, and it is separable from item 1.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc assignment order for the short-lived coordinate temps in the inner loop; ours reuses $v0 for both the x store and the y read, target uses $v0 then $v1.
frontier.next_probe: Only if item 1 does not collapse it. Inner-body respellings are already measured dead (the s2 KILLED entry), so the lever must come from outside the body - the loop-bottom sll, the sentinel read pair (lh/lhu of tbl[0]), or the while-condition spelling. Read .lreg for the y-temp pseudo before inventing anything.

frontier.hypothesis: The LoadImage arg-setup schedule position is a consequence of item 1, not an independent divergence.
frontier.mechanism: The rematerialized la insns are inserted by reload AFTER sched1, so only sched2 can move them; with the hoist gone they would be born before sched1 and could take target's top-of-body slot.
frontier.next_probe: Re-diff after item 1 lands. Only if it survives, read .sched/.sched2 for the arg pseudos - do not tune it independently first.
